mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0%, it indicates a severe labor market downturn that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals a dual shock to the labor market and supply chain, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE rising and INDPRO falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550,000 units, it indicates a weakening in the housing market and overall consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 550 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of weak industrial production (INDPRO) and strong retail sales (RSAFS) signals an imbalance where supply cannot meet demand, causing inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO falling and RSAFS rising) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually), strong consumer demand (RSAFS) drives corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
